short_description: AI Collections, Overdue Debt Recovery & Business Memory for African SMEs
full_description:
Netify is the premier AI Business Command Center and debt recovery intelligence platform built specifically for growing African SMEs, merchants, and founders.

Key Features:
• AI Business Command Center: Instant clarity on what requires your attention today — outstanding debts, overdue accounts, payment commitments, and high-risk cases.
• Multilingual AI Copilot: Converse naturally in English, Hausa, Yoruba, Igbo, and Nigerian Pidgin. Ask questions about who owes you and get grounded, data-backed answers.
• Cultural Debt Collection Intelligence: Professional, tone-adjusted collection messaging (WhatsApp, SMS, scripts) tailored to African commerce etiquette.
• Business Memory: Track customer payment habits, disputes, partial payments, and commitments with automated timeline logging.
• Strict Organization Security: Enterprise-grade tenant isolation with biometric authentication (Face ID & Fingerprint) optimized for Samsung Knox.

Take control of your business cash flow with Netify.
